events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedic legend John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Monty Python & Fawlty Towers
angles.copy: To mark John Cleese turning 87, we're asking: what's his most iconic moment? Is it a classic Monty Python sketch or a memorable Fawlty Towers outburst?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, 'The Beatles', widely known as the 'White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles dropped the iconic 'White Album'. Which track from this double LP is still on your playlist?

events.title: Freddie Mercury death anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Tribute to Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, 35 years on. His incredible voice and showmanship continue to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on December 3, 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Influence
angles.copy: On this day in 1965, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. A landmark album that pushed boundaries – what's your favourite track?

events.title: John Lennon death anniversary
events.blurb: December 8th marks 46 years since the tragic death of The Beatles' co-founder, John Lennon, in 1980.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, we lost a true visionary. Remembering the enduring legacy of John Lennon.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Legendary musician David Bowie, born January 8, 1947, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie's 80th
angles.copy: Celebrating the incredible artistry of David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today. Which era of Bowie's genius is your favourite?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The 'King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, born January 8, 1935, would have been 92 today.

angles.name: King's 92nd
angles.copy: Happy 92nd heavenly birthday to the King, Elvis Presley! Still shaking up the airwaves. What's your top Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock icon Jimmy Page, born January 9, 1944, celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Guitar God's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! What's your favourite Led Zeppelin riff?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: British rock and pop icon Sir Rod Stewart, born January 10, 1945, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod the Mod's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the incomparable Rod Stewart! Still got that raspy charm. What's his best song?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the iconic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today (born January 13, 1961).

angles.name: Madness Frontman
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the voice of Madness! From 'Our House' to 'It Must Be Love', what's your top Madness tune?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)', celebrates his 71st birthday today (born January 17, 1956).

angles.name: Paul Young's Voice
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the soulful Paul Young! Which of his classic tracks takes you back?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music legend and cultural icon Dolly Parton, born January 19, 1946, celebrates her 81st birthday.

angles.name: Queen of Country's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true inspiration in music and beyond. What's your favourite Dolly hit?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow, born January 20, 1971, celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Gary Barlow's Big Day
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Take That's Gary Barlow! What's your favourite song penned by the pop maestro?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British R&B and soul singer Billy Ocean, known for hits like 'Caribbean Queen', celebrates his 77th birthday today (born January 21, 1950).

angles.name: Billy Ocean's Hits
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the incredible Billy Ocean! Get outta our dreams and into our cars with his timeless hits. What's your favourite?

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame's first induction
events.blurb: The first-ever Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held on January 23, 1986, honouring pioneers like Elvis Presley, Chuck Berry, and James Brown.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: On this day in 1986, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its first induction. Who do you think was the most deserving of those initial inductees?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen, born January 27, 1972, celebrates his 55th birthday.

angles.name: Mark Owen's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! From boyband heartthrob to solo artist, what's your favourite Mark Owen moment?

events.title: The Beatles' rooftop concert anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their famous impromptu rooftop concert on the Apple Corps building in London on January 30, 1969, their final public performance.

angles.name: Rooftop Flashback
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles made history with their iconic rooftop concert. Imagine being there! What's your favourite track from that legendary set?

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Drummer, singer, and songwriter Phil Collins, born January 30, 1951, celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Phil Collins' Legacy
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! From Genesis to his solo superstardom, what's your top Phil track?

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: British actor Hugh Grant, known for his roles in romantic comedies and dramas, celebrates his 67th birthday today (born September 9, 1960).

angles.name: Hugh Grant's Charm
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the ever-charming Hugh Grant! What's your favourite Hugh Grant film that always makes you smile?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake, born January 31, 1981, celebrates his 46th birthday.

angles.name: JT's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the Prince of Pop, Justin Timberlake! From NSYNC to solo hits, what's your favourite JT banger?
